solves.reasoning: research suggests octopus HAS ~500M neurons → possesses; the point is the system is unusual → unusual; neurons spread through arms vs concentrated in brain → distributed. possesses/unusual/distributed = 3.
controlling complex movements → complex; responding to sensory input locally (local control theme) → locally; interact with environment directly → directly. complex/locally/directly = 2.
suckers provide strong grip → strong; also detect chemical signals → detect; allows animal to gather chemical info → gather. strong/detect/gather = 4.
② incapable of controlling movements contradicts the passage (arms CAN control movements); others (unusual/directly/strong) fit. Answer ②.
④ lose chemical information contradicts 'gather'; roughly/complex/chemical all fit. Answer ④.
① 'distributed...rather than distributed in the central brain' is self-contradictory; 'rather than' needs opposite (concentrated). require/detect/taste fit. Answer ①.
'provide strong ___ but also detect signals on surfaces' → suckers provide grip. grip = 3.
'___ throughout the arms rather than concentrated entirely in the central brain' → opposite of concentrated = distributed = 1.
'do not require detailed ___ from the brain itself' → instructions/commands. instructions = 2.
roughly five hundred million = about/around → approximately = 2; exactly is opposite.
unusual = not common/strange → uncommon = 3; frequent/simple/pleasant do not match.
detect chemical signals = perceive → sense = 1; ignore is opposite.
complex antonym = simple = 3; complicated/difficult are near-synonyms, heavy is a different axis.
central antonym = peripheral = 2; main/inner are near-central, distant is a different (distance) axis.
(A) octopus's arms = limbs 팔; (B) lay down their arms = weapons 무기. (A)팔 — (B)무기 = 1.
a cell carrying information via signals in the nervous system = neuron = 4; signal is carried not a cell, muscle/sucker are not cells.
'capable of __ (control)' — preposition 'of' + parallel with 'responding' requires gerund → controlling.
'can __ (effective) taste' — modifies the verb taste, so adverb needed → effectively.
'distributed ___ rather than concentrated entirely in the central brain' → location opposite to brain = throughout the arms = 1.
'arms function as extensions that ___' — arms act on their own, so interact with the environment directly = 4; others contradict the passage.
